limitations: The table contains 27 rows from 26 named events and is not continuous Arabian Sea coverage.
As, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb and Zn are reported in mg/kg on bulk marine sediment.
The publisher parameter metadata names the method only as 'Geochemical analysis on bulk sediment'; the adapter preserves that wording and does not invent an instrument or digestion.
One sample label occurs twice as separate analytical rows; source row identity is retained so the replicate is not overwritten.
Core type, water depth and sediment depth are retained independently from elemental values.
